# Investor Loan Exchange

> A loan scenario exchange for investment-property and home equity lending. A broker submits one loan scenario; it is checked against each lender's niche (product, state, property type, loan size); each fitting panel lender receives one structured rate request; quotes come back to one place, side by side, and the broker chooses who to engage. People and AI agents use the same intake.

Schema version: 1.8 (scenario.schema.json)

## What agents can do here

- Read the scenario format and prepare a loan scenario on a broker's behalf, field for field, validating against scenario.schema.json.
- Intake is the multi-step form at the site (anchor #intake). It has a scenario.json loader above the form: paste a valid file and the form prefills for the human to review. It currently runs in test mode: it validates the entry and shows the exact JSON record, but does not transmit it. When live intake is switched on, submissions will go to an endpoint named on this page.
- The scenario record is lender-facing. The submitter's contact details are collected separately in the form and withheld from lenders until the submitter chooses to engage.
- Name the preparing agent in prepared_by. Never put the borrower's or broker's name in notes.
- ltv, estimated_dscr, loan_to_cost and loan_to_arv are computed by the intake and marked illustrative. An agent may include its own estimates; the intake recomputes them from the numbers. A prepared_by in the file survives the round trip - the intake keeps it instead of restamping.
- Agents prepare and prefill. The human submitter personally reviews the scenario and checks the consent box; never mark consent on a person's behalf, and leave the consent object out of the file - the form adds it when the human submits.
- Quotes and questions always go back to the person on the scenario. The agent prepares; the broker decides.

## Never include in a scenario

- SSNs, dates of birth, or other government identifiers
- Bank account numbers or statements
- Borrower or guarantor names (in notes or anywhere lender-facing)
- Documents of any kind - scenarios only

## Required base fields

schema_version ("1.8"), product, purpose, property, loan_amount_usd, credit_band, citizenship. property requires type, occupancy, state and est_value_usd. Extra fields are rejected (additionalProperties is false everywhere).

Formats that trip validators:

- state: two uppercase letters ("NJ"). zip optional.
- occupancy: the literal string "investment", except on the home_equity lane, which also accepts "owner_occupied" (a primary home). Owner-occupied is rejected on every other lane.
- Money fields are numbers, not strings (450000, not "450,000").
- ltv is a decimal (0.75, not 75). Same for estimated_dscr as a ratio (1.21).
- product: dscr_rental, fix_flip, bridge, ground_up_construction, cash_out_refi, conforming_agency, home_equity.
- purpose: purchase, refinance, rate_term_refi, cash_out, equity_draw. Allowed values depend on product: dscr_rental and conforming_agency take purchase, rate_term_refi or cash_out; fix_flip and ground_up_construction take purchase or refinance; bridge takes purchase, refinance or cash_out; cash_out_refi is always cash_out; home_equity is always equity_draw.
- credit_band keeps its display form: 780+, 740-779, 700-739, 660-699, 620-659, below_620.
- citizenship: us_person, foreign_national.
- property.condition: turnkey, light_rehab, heavy_rehab, shell.
- property.type: one of single_family, 2_4_unit, condo, townhome, small_multifamily_5, mixed_use, other.
- liquidity_band: 3_months, 6_months, 12_plus_months. vesting: llc, personal_name, trust, other_entity.

Optional base fields: role (broker or borrower), target_close (ISO date, "2026-12-15"), experience (one of: First deal, 1-3 properties, 4-10 properties, 10+ properties), notes (free text for lenders; never names or identifiers).

## Lane-specific fields

- dscr_rental: monthly_rent_usd (required); monthly_taxes_usd, monthly_insurance_usd, monthly_hoa_usd sharpen the DSCR estimate.
- fix_flip: arv_usd and rehab_budget_usd (required); exit_strategy (sell, refinance_into_dscr, undecided); flip_experience one of 0, 1-2, 3-5, 6+.
- bridge: bridge_exit_strategy (sell, refinance_into_dscr, refinance_into_conventional, undecided) and bridge_term (up_to_6_months, 6_12_months, 12_24_months), both required. Note the bridge exit enum adds refinance_into_conventional; the fix & flip exit_strategy enum does not have it.
- ground_up_construction: project_budget_usd, build_timeline (under_9_months, 9_12_months, 12_18_months, over_18_months) and guc_exit_strategy (sell, refinance_into_dscr, undecided), all required; land_status (owned, under_contract, not_yet) optional.
- cash_out_refi: no extra fields.
- home_equity: home_equity_type (heloc, home_equity_loan) required. Accepts occupancy "owner_occupied" or "investment". rate_type fits a line or a second lien: "Fixed", "Floating" or "No preference"; no prepay_tolerance. first_mortgage_balance_usd optional: current first-mortgage balance; the record then carries cltv = (first_mortgage_balance_usd + loan_amount_usd) / est_value_usd.
- conforming_agency: conforming.under_county_limit is required and is the string "yes", "no" or "not_sure" (not a boolean). conforming.dti_band optional: under_36, 36_43, 43_50, over_50, not_sure. conforming.note optional free text for lenders. Agency loans carry no prepayment penalty and are not interest-only, so this lane takes no prepay_tolerance and no interest_only (IO) structure or IO ARM rate type; those values are dropped at intake.

## Preferences by lane

preferences.structure, preferences.rate_type and preferences.prepay_tolerance are optional. Exact tokens:

- structure: amortizing (shown as P&I), interest_only (shown as IO), either. amortizing is dropped on short lanes.
- rate_type (string, exact casing): "30-yr fixed", "ARM", "IO ARM" on long lanes; "Fixed", "Floating" on short lanes; "No preference" on both. The loader accepts the legacy "Interest-only ARM" and rewrites it to "IO ARM".
- prepay_tolerance: long lanes none, up_to_3yr, up_to_5yr, flexible; short lanes none, up_to_6mo, up_to_12mo, flexible.

Short lanes are bridge, ground_up_construction and fix_flip. Long lanes are dscr_rental, cash_out_refi and conforming_agency. conforming_agency takes no prepay_tolerance at all. Values that do not fit the lane are dropped at intake with a note to the reviewer. The loader also says when it rebuilds an older file to the current version, drops unknown fields, or matches a value to the closest valid token.
